question: For each department that grants degrees, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and only include those departments whose average total units is above the overall average total units across all degree-granting departments? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units,
    STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg
  FROM dept_stats
)
SELECT
  ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ds.avg_total_units,
  ds.var_total_units,
  ds.stddev_total_units
FROM dept_stats ds
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ds.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg

overall.avg_all_departments) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte_units AS inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_all_departments FROM (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs) AS overall) SELECT mcf.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.SCHOOL_NAME, mcf.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_variance, us.total_units_stddev, us.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM math_courses_filtered AS mcf JOIN units_stats AS us ON mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME = us.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.total_units_variance DESC

WITH school_avg_units AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), schools_with_physics AS (SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE swp.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swp.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_year_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.average_total_units, d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d.SCHOOL_NAME AS DEPT_SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM school_avg_units AS s JOIN dept_year_stats AS d ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH dept_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING') SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_course_counts ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_counts.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE AS course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.min_total_units, dept_stats.max_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - dept_stats.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.Total_Courses, mcs.course_number, mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcs.TOTAL_UNITS AS math_course_total_units, mcs.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, mcs.min_total_units AS math_min_total_units, mcs.max_total_units AS math_max_total_units, mcs.deviation_from_avg AS math_deviation_from_avg FROM dept_units_stats AS dus LEFT JOIN math_course_stats AS mcs ON dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC, mcs.deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH student_info AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED`), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, WITH student_info AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN   SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units,
    STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units

),

)

  ds.stddev_total_units

WITH dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units,
    STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg
  FROM dept_stats
)
SELECT
  ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ds.avg_total_units,
  ds.var_total_units,
  ds.stddev_total_units
FROM dept_stats ds
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ds.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_units,
    STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS std_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_units) AS overall_avg FROM dept_stats
)
SELECT
  ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ds.avg_units,
  ds.var_units,
  ds.std_units
FROM dept_stats ds
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ds.avg_units > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
